description.en:
NAVIAI I3 is the Zhejiang Humanoid Robot Innovation Center's full-size bipedal platform for movement and manipulation across varied environments. The manufacturer lists a height of 180 cm and 37 degrees of freedom, with coordinated joints and compliant motion control.

The platform combines navigation and positioning with fine-operation development, aiming to connect whole-body mobility to useful physical tasks. Its published figures include maximum joint torque of 360 N·m and movement speed up to 9 km/h under the manufacturer's conditions. These specifications describe the platform's mechanical and motion envelope; practical task performance depends on its software, end effectors and operating setup.
